definitions.gloss: letter of appointment; official notice of personnel change
definitions.explanation: A formal document issued by an organization notifying an employee of appointment, promotion, transfer, or other personnel changes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{辞令|じれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{辞令|じれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人事異動|じんじいどう}→人事異動：18627_jinjiidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{辞令|じれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The personnel change notices for next month were announced.

notes:
TYPES:
- ⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧{辞令|じれい}: letter of appointment on hiring
- ⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧{辞令|じれい}: promotion notice
- ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧{辞令|じれい}: transfer notice

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {辞令|じれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: an official personnel notice is issued
- {辞令|じれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive an official appointment or transfer

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{内示|ないじ}→内示：18056_naiji⟧: the informal advance notice given before the official {辞令|じれい}

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{社交辞令|しゃこうじれい}→社交辞令：11081_shakoujirei⟧ uses the older sense of {辞令|じれい} as "wording": it means polite words not meant literally ("let's have dinner sometime"), and has nothing to do with personnel notices.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Large Japanese organizations issue most {辞令|じれい} at fixed times of year, especially April 1, the start of the fiscal year.
